links.outcome: LLM self-reported confidence ratings relative to diagnostic accuracy
links.effect: Confidence ratings uniformly high regardless of accuracy, mean 93% to 96% (SD 1% to 4%), while diagnostic accuracy was 65% to 74%.
links.quote: Confidence ratings were uniformly high regardless of accuracy, with the mean scores ranging from 93% to 96% and standard deviation ranging from 1% to 4%.

links.outcome: Accuracy of LLM diagnosis and treatment recommendations against Rome IV MDCP guidance
links.effect: Diagnostic accuracy 65% to 74%; treatment accuracy 41% to 54%; no significant differences between models.
links.quote: Diagnostic accuracy across models demonstrated Perplexity at 74%, ChatGPT and Google Gemini at 72% respectively, and Microsoft Copilot and OpenEvidence at 65% respectively.

screen.reason: Evaluated the diagnostic and treatment recommendation accuracy and confidence calibration of five off-the-shelf LLMs across 68 clinical vignettes from the Rome IV profile without testing a deployment practice.
